# External pixel-art assets

- GothicVania Town by Luis Zuno / Ansimuz, downloaded from https://opengameart.org/content/gothicvania-town. The OpenGameArt page marks the pack CC0 / public domain.
- Magical Road Pixel Art Environment by Ansimuz, downloaded from https://opengameart.org/content/magical-road-pixel-art-environment. The OpenGameArt page marks the pack CC0.
- Kenney Pixel Platformer tiles, downloaded from https://kenney.nl/assets/pixel-platformer. Kenney publishes this pack under CC0.
- Kenney UI Pack - Pixel Adventure, downloaded from https://kenney.nl/assets/ui-pack-pixel-adventure. Kenney publishes this pack under CC0.
- SunnyLand Tall Forest Environment by Luis Zuno / ansimuz. Source: https://opengameart.org/content/sunnyland-tall-forest-environment; archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/tall_forest_files.zip. License: CC0 1.0 Universal (OpenGameArt listing); downloaded 2026-07-19. Attribution is optional; the source license is retained at `sunnyland-tall-forest/source-license.txt`.
- Parallax background forest pixel art by MatiasVME. Source: https://opengameart.org/content/parallax-background-forest-pixel-art; archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/parallax_background_forest.zip. License: CC0 1.0 Universal (OpenGameArt listing); downloaded 2026-07-19. Attribution is not required by the source.
